name: Godot demo projects
description: Official demonstration and template projects covering reusable Godot mechanics, rendering techniques, UI, networking, and engine patterns.

licence.notice: The official repository states its demos are MIT licensed. Preserve required MIT notice; verify any third-party asset notices within the selected demo.

provenance.notes: Official Godot Engine repository. Individual bundled third-party assets may carry additional notices and must be checked before reuse.

maintenance.evidence: Official repository had commits in 2026 and documents branches aligned to engine versions.
maintenance.notes: Pin the branch/tag/commit compatible with the project's target stable Godot version.

compatibility.notes: Use a branch/tag compatible with the target stable Godot release rather than blindly using master.

risk.legalNotes: Repository is MIT, but selected demos can contain third-party asset notices that must be preserved/checked separately.
risk.securityNotes: Reference code must still undergo normal dependency, code, and project-specific security review before production reuse.

assessment.notes: Strong first-party reference source for solved mechanics and engine patterns; project-specific execution is still required before promotion into production code.

evidence.notes: Repository README identifies the demos as MIT licensed and documents version branches.

publication.notes: Publication may summarize By JTT evaluation and link upstream; do not republish third-party assets without checking their notices.
